parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for human 5-lipoxygenase. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target name '5-lipoxygenase' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50' with standard_relation '=' and standard_units 'nM'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
